===Etymology 1===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*leyp-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|leven}}, from {{inh|en|ang|lǣfan|t=to leave}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*laibijan}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*laibijaną|t=to let stay, leave}}, causative of {{m|gem-pro|*lībaną|t=to stay, remain}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*leyp-|t=to stick; fat}}.

Cognate with {{cog|ofs|lēva|t=to leave}}, dialectal {{cog|nl|loven|t=to have left over, save, keep}}, {{cog|osx|lēvian}}, {{cog|goh|leiban|t=to leave}}, {{cog|non|leifa|t=to leave over}} (whence {{cog|is|leifa|t=to leave food uneaten}}, {{cog|sv|leva|t=to leave}}), {{m|is|lifna|t=to be left}} (whence {{cog|da|levne}}). More at [[lave#Etymology_2|lave]], [[belive#Etymology_1|belive]].

The noun is attested since the 19th century, with earliest references to billiards.
